name: scanner-cli
body: The `apg` binary: the scan driver and ingestor (`src/main.rs`, `src/ingest.rs`, `src/load.rs`), the shared fact cache (`src/cache.rs`), the delta/freshness logic (`src/delta.rs`), git identity (`src/git.rs`), and the project lifecycle (`src/project_cmd.rs`, `src/splice.rs`). It owns canonical identity resolution, scan hygiene, and the project-start seeding path.
